1	import type { BrowserApi, ContextualIdentity, MenusOnClickInfo, PctSettings, Tab } from '../models'
2	import type { TcLayer } from './tcLayer'
3	import type { TabReopener } from './tabReopener'
4	import {
5		MENU_OPEN_NEW,
6		MENU_REOPEN,
7		NO_CONTAINER,
8		TEMP_CONTAINER_SENTINEL,
9	} from '../constants'
10	
11	export interface MenuHandlerDeps {
12		readonly browserApi: BrowserApi
13		readonly tcLayer: TcLayer
14		readonly tabReopener: TabReopener
15	}
16	
17	export interface MenuHandler {
18		initialize(): Promise<void>
19		buildMenus(tab: Tab, settings: PctSettings, permanentContainers: ContextualIdentity[]): Promise<void>
20		handleClick(info: MenusOnClickInfo, tab: Tab): Promise<void>
21		handleHidden(): void
22		markTabAsPctOpened(tabId: number): void
23	}
24	
25	export class MenuHandlerImpl implements MenuHandler {
26		private readonly browserApi: BrowserApi
27		private readonly tcLayer: TcLayer
28		private readonly tabReopener: TabReopener
29		private _containerCache: ContextualIdentity[] | null = null
30	
31		constructor(deps: MenuHandlerDeps) {
32			this.browserApi = deps.browserApi
33			this.tcLayer = deps.tcLayer
34			this.tabReopener = deps.tabReopener
35		}
36	
37		async initialize(): Promise<void> {
38			// Nothing to do at initialization — listeners are registered by PctRuntime
39		}
40	
41		async buildMenus(tab: Tab, settings: PctSettings, permanentContainers: ContextualIdentity[]): Promise<void> {
42			this._containerCache = permanentContainers
43	
44			await this.browserApi.menus.removeAll()
45	
46			if (settings.prioritizeReopen) {
47				await this.buildContainerSubmenu(MENU_REOPEN, 'Reopen Tab in Container', tab, permanentContainers)
48			} else {
49				await this.buildContainerSubmenu(MENU_OPEN_NEW, 'Open in New Container Tab', tab, permanentContainers)
50			}
51	
52			await this.browserApi.menus.refresh()
53		}
54	
55		private async buildContainerSubmenu(
56			parentId: string,
57			title: string,
58			tab: Tab,
59			permanentContainers: ContextualIdentity[],
60		): Promise<void> {
61			// Create parent item
62			await this.browserApi.menus.create({
63				id: parentId,
64				title,
65				contexts: ['tab'],
66			})
67	
68			// No Container — no icon, always radio
69			const noContainerIsCurrent = tab.cookieStoreId === NO_CONTAINER || !tab.cookieStoreId
70			await this.browserApi.menus.create({
71				id: `${parentId}-${NO_CONTAINER}`,
72				parentId,
73				title: 'No Container',
74				type: 'radio',
75				checked: noContainerIsCurrent,
76				enabled: !noContainerIsCurrent,
77				contexts: ['tab'],
78			})
79	
80			// Temporary Container — radio if current tab is in TC, normal+icon otherwise
81			if (this.tcLayer.isPresent()) {
82				const tabIsInTc = !!tab.cookieStoreId && await this.tcLayer.isTempContainer(tab.cookieStoreId)
83				await this.browserApi.menus.create({
84					id: `${parentId}-${TEMP_CONTAINER_SENTINEL}`,
85					parentId,
86					title: 'Temporary Container',
87					type: tabIsInTc ? 'radio' : 'normal',
88					checked: tabIsInTc,
89					enabled: !tabIsInTc,
90					contexts: ['tab'],
91					...(tabIsInTc ? {} : { icons: { 16: 'icons/temp-container.svg' } }),
92				})
93			}
94	
95			// Permanent containers — bundled SVG icon (icons/${icon}.svg#${color}) replaces
96			// radio button when not current; radio indicator replaces icon when current.
97			for (const container of permanentContainers) {
98				const isCurrent = tab.cookieStoreId === container.cookieStoreId
99				const bundledIcon = `icons/${container.icon}.svg#${container.color}`
100				await this.browserApi.menus.create({
101					id: `${parentId}-${container.cookieStoreId}`,
102					parentId,
103					title: container.name,
104					type: isCurrent ? 'radio' : 'normal',
105					checked: isCurrent,
106					enabled: !isCurrent,
107					contexts: ['tab'],
108					...(isCurrent ? {} : { icons: { 16: bundledIcon } }),
109				})
110			}
111		}
112	
113		async handleClick(info: MenusOnClickInfo, tab: Tab): Promise<void> {
114			const itemId = info.menuItemId
115	
116			if (itemId.startsWith(`${MENU_OPEN_NEW}-`)) {
117				const cookieStoreId = itemId.slice(`${MENU_OPEN_NEW}-`.length)
118				if (cookieStoreId === NO_CONTAINER) {
119					// Open in default container — no cookieStoreId
120					await this.browserApi.tabs.create({ ...(tab.url !== undefined ? { url: tab.url } : {}), index: tab.index + 1 })
121				} else if (cookieStoreId === TEMP_CONTAINER_SENTINEL) {
122					await this.tcLayer.createTempContainer(tab.url ?? '', tab.index + 1, tab.windowId ?? 0)
123				} else {
124					await this.browserApi.tabs.create({ ...(tab.url !== undefined ? { url: tab.url } : {}), cookieStoreId, index: tab.index + 1 })
125				}
126			} else if (itemId.startsWith(`${MENU_REOPEN}-`)) {
127				const cookieStoreId = itemId.slice(`${MENU_REOPEN}-`.length)
128				await this.tabReopener.reopen(tab, cookieStoreId)
129			}
130		}
131	
132		handleHidden(): void {
133			this._containerCache = null
134		}
135	
136		markTabAsPctOpened(_tabId: number): void {
137			// No-op here — pctRuntime manages the set
138		}
139	}

1	# Permanent Container Tabs — Specification
2	
3	## Overview
4	
5	**Permanent Container Tabs (PCT)** is a Firefox extension that replaces and extends the tab
6	context-menu items provided by the Multi-Account Containers (MAC) extension. It surfaces
7	only *permanent* (non-temporary) containers in its picker, integrates with Temporary Containers
8	(TC / TC+), and adds a robust "Reopen Tab in Container" action. An informational page explains
9	to users why a tab was silently moved into a Temporary Container when TC's global-isolation mode
10	is active.
11	
12	---
13	
14	## Feature List
15	
16	### F1 — Context Menu: "Open in New Container Tab"
17	- Appears on right-click of any browser tab (contexts: `["tab"]`).
18	- Submenu lists all permanent (non-temporary) `contextualIdentities`.
19	- Each entry is a radio-button when it matches the current tab's container (`checked: true`,
20	  `enabled: false`, no icon); otherwise `type: normal` with a bundled SVG icon.
21	- Special entries always present at the top:
22	  - **No Container** (`firefox-default`) — always `type: radio`; checked when the tab is in
23	    no container.
24	  - **Temporary Container** — only shown when TC/TC+ is installed; shown as radio + checked
25	    when the current tab is itself in a temporary container; otherwise `type: normal` with the
26	    bundled `temp-container.svg` icon.
27	- Clicking an entry opens a **new tab** (active) in the chosen container at the same URL.
28	- Controlled by **Setting S1** (`prioritizeReopen: false` → shows this menu).
29	
30	### F2 — Context Menu: "Reopen Tab in Container"
31	- Second top-level item in the tab context menu.
32	- Same submenu structure as F1 (permanent containers + No Container + Temporary Container).
33	- Clicking an entry:
34	  1. Opens the URL in a **new active tab** in the chosen container at index = old tab index + 1.
35	  2. Closes the original tab.
36	  3. **TC intercept check** — skipped when the chosen container is Temporary Container or TC
37	     is not present. Waits 500 ms, then polls every 200 ms for up to 2 s (10 polls). On each
38	     poll, reads the new tab via `tabs.get`. If the tab's `cookieStoreId` is now a Temporary
39	     Container (TC's global-isolation mode intercepted the navigation) and
40	     `suppressIsolationInfo` is `false`, opens `isolation-info.html` in a new active tab and
41	     stops polling. If `tabs.get` throws (TC closed our tab and replaced it), stops silently.
42	- Controlled by **Setting S2** (`prioritizeReopen: true` → shows this menu instead of F1).
43	
44	### F4 — TC Global-Isolation Info Page
45	- When TC/TC+ is installed with global-isolation mode enabled and a navigation lands the
46	  tab in a Temporary Container (detected via `tabs.onUpdated` + `isTempContainer` check),
47	  PCT opens `src/info/isolation-info.html` in the tab (one additional tab, not replacing
48	  the destination).
49	- The page:
50	  - Explains that TC's global-isolation mode redirected the tab.
51	  - Provides links to TC documentation (TC README and TC+ README, URLs sourced from CM
52	    project README).
53	  - **"OK"** button — closes the info tab.
54	  - **"Never show again"** button — persists `suppressIsolationInfo: true` to storage and
55	    closes the info tab.
56	- PCT never opens the info page when `suppressIsolationInfo` is `true`.
57	- Controlled by **Setting S4** (`suppressIsolationInfo`, default `false`).
58	
59	---
60	
61	## Settings
62	
63	| Key | Type | Default | Description |
64	|-----|------|---------|-------------|
65	| `prioritizeReopen` | boolean | `false` | `false` = show F1 (Open in New), `true` = show F2 (Reopen) |
66	| `suppressIsolationInfo` | boolean | `false` | Never show TC isolation info page |
67	
68	Settings are stored via `browser.storage.local`.
69	
70	---
71	
72	## Architecture
73	
74	```
75	src/
76	├── manifest.json             MV2, gecko id: pct@permanentcontainertabs
77	├── background.ts             Entry point — constructs and initialises PctRuntime
78	├── constants.ts              TEMP_CONTAINERS_EXTENSION_IDS, NO_CONTAINER, TEMP_CONTAINER_SENTINEL, etc.
79	├── models.ts                 All TypeScript interfaces (BrowserApi, PctSettings, ContextualIdentity, …)
80	├── background/
81	│   ├── pctRuntime.ts         Orchestrator — wires listeners, owns module instances
82	│   ├── menuHandler.ts        Tab context menu: build, show, handle clicks (F1/F2)
83	│   ├── tabReopener.ts        "Reopen" action: open new tab, close old, TC intercept check (F2)
84	│   └── tcLayer.ts            TC/TC+ detection, isTempContainer, createTempContainer
85	├── preferences/
86	│   ├── options.html          Settings page UI
87	│   ├── options.ts            Form binding / settings persistence
88	│   └── settings.ts           Settings schema, defaults, validation
89	└── info/
90	    ├── isolation-info.html   TC isolation informational page
91	    └── isolation-info.ts     Button handlers (OK / Never show again)
92	tests/
93	├── menuHandler.test.ts
94	├── tabReopener.test.ts
95	├── tcLayer.test.ts
96	├── settings.test.ts
97	├── pctRuntime.test.ts
98	└── isolationInfo.test.ts
99	icons/
100	└── icon.svg                  Extension icon (also used as menu item icon)
101	```
102	
103	---
104	
105	## Manifest Permissions
106	
107	```json
108	{
109	  "permissions": [
110	    "tabs",
111	    "menus",
112	    "contextMenus",
113	    "contextualIdentities",
114	    "cookies",
115	    "storage",
116	    "management",
117	    "<all_urls>"
118	  ]
119	}
120	```
121	
122	`management` is required to probe TC/TC+ extension IDs via `browser.management.get()`.
123	`<all_urls>` is required to open the info page via `tabs.update`.
124	
125	---
126	
127	## Key Technical Details
128	
129	### Container Filtering (TC exclusion)
130	`browser.contextualIdentities.query({})` returns all containers. After fetching, PCT calls
131	`tcLayer.isTempContainer(cookieStoreId)` for each and filters out positives before building
132	the submenu. Results are cached per `menus.onShown` event (one cache per menu open cycle).
133	
134	### Current-Container Indicator (F1 / F2)
135	When building the submenu for a right-clicked tab, PCT reads `tab.cookieStoreId` and marks
136	the matching container entry as `checked: true` / `type: radio` / `enabled: false` with no
137	icon. This applies to the No Container entry, all permanent container entries, and the
138	Temporary Container entry (which calls `isTempContainer(tab.cookieStoreId)` to detect the
139	current-tab case).
140	
141	### "Reopen Tab in Container" Flow (F2)
142	1. Call TC API (if Temporary Container selected) or `browser.tabs.create({ url, cookieStoreId, index, active: true })`.
143	2. Close the original tab via `browser.tabs.remove(oldTabId)`.
144	3. **TC intercept check** (skipped for Temporary Container target or when TC is absent):
145	   - `await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500))` — initial 500 ms delay.
146	   - Loop up to 10 times (2 s polling window at 200 ms/poll). Each iteration:
147	     - **Check A — created tab by ID:** `tabs.get(newTabId)`. If it throws (TC removed it),
148	       note it as gone and continue to Check B. If the tab's `cookieStoreId` is a TC
149	       container → TC intercepted (see below).
150	     - **Check B — window scan:** `tabs.query({ windowId })`, skip `newTabId`. For each
151	       other tab whose URL matches the original URL and whose `cookieStoreId` is a TC
152	       container → TC intercepted (see below).
153	     - **TC intercepted:** if `!suppressIsolationInfo`:
154	       `browser.tabs.create({ url: infoUrl, active: true })`; return.
155	     - If neither check found TC: sleep 200 ms and continue (even if the created tab is gone,
156	       keep watching — TC may still be creating the replacement).
157	
158	### TC Global Isolation Detection (F4)
159	1. On `tabs.onUpdated` (with `changeInfo.cookieStoreId`), check if the new `cookieStoreId`
160	   is a TC container via `tcLayer.isTempContainer()`.
161	2. Cross-reference: if the URL is NOT `about:blank`/`about:newtab` and the tab was NOT
162	   opened by PCT itself (`pctOpenedTabIds` set), open the info page.
163	3. `pctOpenedTabIds` is populated in F1/F2 and cleared after `tabs.onUpdated` fires for
164	   that tab (one-shot sentinel).
165	
166	---
167	
168	## Test Plan (TDD — write tests before implementation)
169	
170	### `settings.test.ts`
171	- `getDefaultSettings()` returns both keys with correct defaults.
172	- `validateSettings()` rejects non-boolean values.
173	- `loadSettings()` merges stored partial with defaults (missing keys filled in).
174	- `saveSettings()` calls `browser.storage.local.set` with correct payload.
175	
176	### `tcLayer.test.ts`
177	- `initialize()` detects first installed/enabled TC extension; skips disabled ones.
178	- `initialize()` sets `extensionId = null` when neither extension is installed.

189	- Current tab in No Container: No Container entry is checked.

196	### `tabReopener.test.ts`
197	- `reopen(tab, NO_CONTAINER)` creates tab at `index+1` with `active: true`, closes original.

210	  whose URL matches the original URL (Check B — handles TC closing our tab and spawning a
211	  replacement). Continues polling even if `tabs.get` throws (tab gone, replacement may appear).
212	- TC replacement tab with non-matching URL is ignored.
213	- When no TC intercept is found after all 10 polls, resolves silently.
214	
215	### `pctRuntime.test.ts`
216	- `initialize()` calls `tcLayer.initialize()`, `menuHandler.initialize()`, and registers listeners.

221	- Info page opened via `tabs.create({ url: 'info/isolation-info.html' })`.
222	
223	### `isolationInfo.test.ts`

225	- "Never show again" button sets `suppressIsolationInfo: true` and closes the info tab.

# Permanent Container Tabs — Specification

## Overview

**Permanent Container Tabs (PCT)** is a Firefox extension that replaces and extends the tab
context-menu items provided by the Multi-Account Containers (MAC) extension. It surfaces
only *permanent* (non-temporary) containers in its picker, integrates with Temporary Containers
(TC / TC+), and adds a robust "Reopen Tab in Container" action. An informational page explains
to users why a tab was silently moved into a Temporary Container when TC's global-isolation mode
is active.

---

## Feature List

### F1 — Context Menu: "Open in New Container Tab"
- Appears on right-click of any browser tab (contexts: `["tab"]`).
- Submenu lists all permanent (non-temporary) `contextualIdentities`.
- Each entry is a radio-button when it matches the current tab's container (`checked: true`,
  `enabled: false`, no icon); otherwise `type: normal` with a bundled SVG icon.
- Special entries always present at the top:
  - **No Container** (`firefox-default`) — always `type: radio`; checked when the tab is in
    no container.
  - **Temporary Container** — only shown when TC/TC+ is installed; shown as radio + checked
    when the current tab is itself in a temporary container; otherwise `type: normal` with the
    bundled `temp-container.svg` icon.
- Clicking an entry opens a **new tab** (active) in the chosen container at the same URL.
- Controlled by **Setting S1** (`prioritizeReopen: false` → shows this menu).

### F2 — Context Menu: "Reopen Tab in Container"
- Second top-level item in the tab context menu.
- Same submenu structure as F1 (permanent containers + No Container + Temporary Container).
- Clicking an entry:
  1. Opens the URL in a **new active tab** in the chosen container at index = old tab index + 1.
  2. Closes the original tab.
  3. **TC intercept check** — skipped when the chosen container is Temporary Container or TC
     is not present. Waits 500 ms, then polls every 200 ms for up to 2 s (10 polls). On each
     poll, reads the new tab via `tabs.get`. If the tab's `cookieStoreId` is now a Temporary
     Container (TC's global-isolation mode intercepted the navigation) and
     `suppressIsolationInfo` is `false`, opens `isolation-info.html` in a new active tab and
     stops polling. If `tabs.get` throws (TC closed our tab and replaced it), stops silently.
- Controlled by **Setting S2** (`prioritizeReopen: true` → shows this menu instead of F1).

### F4 — TC Global-Isolation Info Page
- When TC/TC+ is installed with global-isolation mode enabled and a navigation lands the
  tab in a Temporary Container (detected via `tabs.onUpdated` + `isTempContainer` check),
  PCT opens `src/info/isolation-info.html` in the tab (one additional tab, not replacing
  the destination).
- The page:
  - Explains that TC's global-isolation mode redirected the tab.
  - Provides links to TC documentation (TC README and TC+ README, URLs sourced from CM
    project README).
  - **"OK"** button — closes the info tab.
  - **"Never show again"** button — persists `suppressIsolationInfo: true` to storage and
    closes the info tab.
- PCT never opens the info page when `suppressIsolationInfo` is `true`.
- Controlled by **Setting S4** (`suppressIsolationInfo`, default `false`).

---

## Settings

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|-----|------|---------|-------------|
| `prioritizeReopen` | boolean | `false` | `false` = show F1 (Open in New), `true` = show F2 (Reopen) |
| `suppressIsolationInfo` | boolean | `false` | Never show TC isolation info page |

Settings are stored via `browser.storage.local`.

---

## Architecture

```
src/
├── manifest.json             MV2, gecko id: pct@permanentcontainertabs
├── background.ts             Entry point — constructs and initialises PctRuntime
├── constants.ts              TEMP_CONTAINERS_EXTENSION_IDS, NO_CONTAINER, TEMP_CONTAINER_SENTINEL, etc.
├── models.ts                 All TypeScript interfaces (BrowserApi, PctSettings, ContextualIdentity, …)
├── background/
│   ├── pctRuntime.ts         Orchestrator — wires listeners, owns module instances
│   ├── menuHandler.ts        Tab context menu: build, show, handle clicks (F1/F2)
│   ├── tabReopener.ts        "Reopen" action: open new tab, close old, TC intercept check (F2)
│   └── tcLayer.ts            TC/TC+ detection, isTempContainer, createTempContainer
├── preferences/
│   ├── options.html          Settings page UI
│   ├── options.ts            Form binding / settings persistence
│   └── settings.ts           Settings schema, defaults, validation
└── info/
    ├── isolation-info.html   TC isolation informational page
    └── isolation-info.ts     Button handlers (OK / Never show again)
tests/
├── menuHandler.test.ts
├── tabReopener.test.ts
├── tcLayer.test.ts
├── settings.test.ts
├── pctRuntime.test.ts
└── isolationInfo.test.ts
icons/
└── icon.svg                  Extension icon (also used as menu item icon)
```

---

## Manifest Permissions

```json
{
  "permissions": [
    "tabs",
    "menus",
    "contextMenus",
    "contextualIdentities",
    "cookies",
    "storage",
    "management",
    "<all_urls>"
  ]
}
```

`management` is required to probe TC/TC+ extension IDs via `browser.management.get()`.
`<all_urls>` is required to open the info page via `tabs.update`.

---

## Key Technical Details

### Container Filtering (TC exclusion)
`browser.contextualIdentities.query({})` returns all containers. After fetching, PCT calls
`tcLayer.isTempContainer(cookieStoreId)` for each and filters out positives before building
the submenu. Results are cached per `menus.onShown` event (one cache per menu open cycle).

### Current-Container Indicator (F1 / F2)
When building the submenu for a right-clicked tab, PCT reads `tab.cookieStoreId` and marks
the matching container entry as `checked: true` / `type: radio` / `enabled: false` with no
icon. This applies to the No Container entry, all permanent container entries, and the
Temporary Container entry (which calls `isTempContainer(tab.cookieStoreId)` to detect the
current-tab case).

### "Reopen Tab in Container" Flow (F2)
1. Call TC API (if Temporary Container selected) or `browser.tabs.create({ url, cookieStoreId, index, active: true })`.
2. Close the original tab via `browser.tabs.remove(oldTabId)`.
3. **TC intercept check** (skipped for Temporary Container target or when TC is absent):
   - `await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500))` — initial 500 ms delay.
   - Loop up to 10 times (2 s polling window at 200 ms/poll). Each iteration:
     - **Check A — created tab by ID:** `tabs.get(newTabId)`. If it throws (TC removed it),
       note it as gone and continue to Check B. If the tab's `cookieStoreId` is a TC
       container → TC intercepted (see below).
     - **Check B — window scan:** `tabs.query({ windowId })`, skip `newTabId`. For each
       other tab whose URL matches the original URL and whose `cookieStoreId` is a TC
       container → TC intercepted (see below).
     - **TC intercepted:** if `!suppressIsolationInfo`:
       `browser.tabs.create({ url: infoUrl, active: true })`; return.
     - If neither check found TC: sleep 200 ms and continue (even if the created tab is gone,
       keep watching — TC may still be creating the replacement).

### TC Global Isolation Detection (F4)
1. On `tabs.onUpdated` (with `changeInfo.cookieStoreId`), check if the new `cookieStoreId`
   is a TC container via `tcLayer.isTempContainer()`.
2. Cross-reference: if the URL is NOT `about:blank`/`about:newtab` and the tab was NOT
   opened by PCT itself (`pctOpenedTabIds` set), open the info page.
3. `pctOpenedTabIds` is populated in F1/F2 and cleared after `tabs.onUpdated` fires for
   that tab (one-shot sentinel).

---

## Test Plan (TDD — write tests before implementation)

### `settings.test.ts`
- `getDefaultSettings()` returns both keys with correct defaults.
- `validateSettings()` rejects non-boolean values.
- `loadSettings()` merges stored partial with defaults (missing keys filled in).
- `saveSettings()` calls `browser.storage.local.set` with correct payload.

### `tcLayer.test.ts`
- `initialize()` detects first installed/enabled TC extension; skips disabled ones.
- `initialize()` sets `extensionId = null` when neither extension is installed.
- `isTempContainer()` returns `true` for a TC container, `false` for a permanent one.
- `isTempContainer()` returns `false` when no TC extension is present (no crash).
- `createTempContainer()` sends correct message to TC extension and returns new tab.

### `menuHandler.test.ts`
- `onShown` with `prioritizeReopen=false` builds "Open in New Container Tab" top-level item.
- `onShown` with `prioritizeReopen=true` builds "Reopen Tab in Container" top-level item.
- Submenu contains exactly `[No Container, (Temporary Container?), ...permanentContainers]`.
- Permanent temporary-container entries are excluded from submenu (filtered by caller).
- Current tab's permanent container is `checked: true`, `type: radio`, no icon.
- Current tab in No Container: No Container entry is checked.
- Current tab in Temporary Container: TC entry is `type: radio`, `checked: true`, no icon.
- Tab not in TC: TC entry is `type: normal` with `icons/temp-container.svg`.
- `onClicked` for F1 item calls `browser.tabs.create` with correct `{url, cookieStoreId}`.
- `onClicked` for F2 item calls `tabReopener.reopen`.
- `onHidden` clears per-cycle container cache.

### `tabReopener.test.ts`
- `reopen(tab, NO_CONTAINER)` creates tab at `index+1` with `active: true`, closes original.
- `reopen(tab, TEMP_CONTAINER_SENTINEL)` calls TC `createTempContainer`, closes original;
  skips the TC intercept check entirely.
- `reopen(tab, permanentCookieStoreId)` creates tab with that `cookieStoreId` and `active: true`.
- After ~400 ms: if new tab's `cookieStoreId` is a TC container, opens info page in a new
  active tab (when `suppressIsolationInfo=false`).
- Does NOT open info page when `suppressIsolationInfo=true`.
- Does NOT open info page when TC is not present.
- Does NOT open info page when the new tab is in a permanent container (no TC intercept).
- TC intercept check is skipped when the chosen container is `TEMP_CONTAINER_SENTINEL`.
- Initial check fires at 500 ms, subsequent polls every 200 ms (up to 10 polls / 2 s).
- Stops polling as soon as TC intercept is detected; does not poll further after detecting.
- Each poll checks both the created tab by ID (Check A) and any other TC tab in the window
  whose URL matches the original URL (Check B — handles TC closing our tab and spawning a
  replacement). Continues polling even if `tabs.get` throws (tab gone, replacement may appear).
- TC replacement tab with non-matching URL is ignored.
- When no TC intercept is found after all 10 polls, resolves silently.

### `pctRuntime.test.ts`
- `initialize()` calls `tcLayer.initialize()`, `menuHandler.initialize()`, and registers listeners.
- `tabs.onUpdated` with `cookieStoreId` change fires isolation-info logic when appropriate.
- `tabs.onUpdated` does NOT open info page if `suppressIsolationInfo=true`.
- `tabs.onUpdated` does NOT open info page for PCT-opened tabs.
- `tabs.onUpdated` does NOT open info page when new container is NOT a temp container.
- Info page opened via `tabs.create({ url: 'info/isolation-info.html' })`.

### `isolationInfo.test.ts`
- "OK" button message handler closes the info tab.
- "Never show again" button sets `suppressIsolationInfo: true` and closes the info tab.

---

## TC Documentation Links (for F4 info page)

- Temporary Containers (stoically): https://github.com/stoically/temporary-containers
- Temporary Containers Plus (GodKratos): https://github.com/GodKratos/temporary-containers

---

## Build System

**Nix flake** providing a `devShell` with `nodejs_22`.

**npm scripts:**
```
build     esbuild src/background.ts src/info/isolation-info.ts
          src/preferences/options.ts --bundle --platform=browser
          --format=iife --target=firefox115 --outdir=src
test      vitest run
typecheck tsc --noEmit
package   web-ext build && mv web-ext-artifacts/*.zip dist/pct.xpi
```

**TypeScript:** strict mode, ES2022, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`.

---

## Non-Goals (v1.0)
- No bookmark management (that is CM's domain).
- No cross-device sync.
- No security tokens / URL encoding.
- No page action button.
